features.title: POS Features for Daily Operations
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run orders, payments, inventory, reports, and teams in one place.

onlineOrdering.title: Online Ordering with Menu Catalog
onlineOrdering.description: Share a menu link or QR code. Customers can browse your catalog and place orders from their phones without installing an app.

payment.title: Customer QRIS Payments
payment.description: Accept instant payments through QRIS with Midtrans. Works well with major e-wallets and banking apps in Indonesia.

offlineOrder.title: Offline Order Management
offlineOrder.description: Record walk-in, phone, or WhatsApp orders in one system. Supports cash payments and installment schedules for orders outside the digital menu.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Track daily revenue, best-selling products, and customer trends from an easy-to-read business dashboard.

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.description: Track stock in real time, get low-stock alerts, and keep an audit trail for every adjustment.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Invite staff by email and assign Owner, Manager, or Cashier roles with access based on responsibility.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: One plan for every feature. Start free with no credit card.
pricing.trialNote: After the free {{days}}-day trial, choose monthly or annual billing. Cancel anytime without a long-term contract.
